evals.prompt: Our SDR agent has drafted 40 emails with a 5% edit rate. Can it start sending without approval?
evals.expected_output: Should grant autonomy per task, not per agent. Should map evidence to a level (e.g. still review sends even if drafting is trusted). Should state promotion evidence thresholds and auto-demotion triggers.
assertions: Autonomy is per task not per agent
Separates drafting autonomy from send autonomy
Mentions demotion triggers if quality slips
